## Overview
- refers to how the residuals are distributed about the mean value
- When residuals are normally distributed:
![[10 Normality of Errors-normally distributed errors.jpg|200]]
![[10 Normality of Errors 09-06-25.excalidraw|600]]
- Can also be diagnosed with a [[QQ-plot]]


## Remedies for non-normality
- change in functional form (try log or other transforms)
